title: Shared tester — CookbookCore parser validation
description: Run the full CookbookCore test suite, verify xcodebuild linkage, and confirm all spec acceptance criteria are met end-to-end.
acceptance_criteria: swift test from Packages/CookbookCore/ exits 0 with all tests green.
xcodebuild test (using the generated .xcodeproj) exits 0 and the test log shows CookbookCoreTests ran.
All quantity table rows from the spec are verified against actual parse output.
All three error cases (empty name, empty value + non-empty unit, double %) correctly throw CooklangError.parse.
Parser determinism: two successive parse calls on the same input return equal Recipe values.
Multi-line block comment test: component inside comment is absent from parsed recipe collections.
No regressions in any pre-existing CookbookApp tests.
